dos.text: Declare your own light-DOM <button dlgtype="accept"> (etc.) if you need custom button behavior, _configureButtons() detects same-dlgtype buttons via getElementsByAttribute("dlgtype", "*"), hides the shadow DOM default of that type, and wires yours up with the same command/label logic instead.

donts.text: Don't call event.preventDefault() on a keypress expecting it to block the accept button from firing on Enter, _hitEnter() runs unconditionally for Return while cancelDialog() on Escape explicitly checks `!event.defaultPrevented` first, so the two keys aren't handled symmetrically.

Don't set extra1-is-secondary expecting it to reorder buttons on every platform, attributeChangedCallback only moves the cancel/extra1 buttons when AppConstants.XP_UNIX is true, since Windows and macOS already bake the intended order into a separate _markup button-box string.
